cards.title: Managing toddler tantrums and teenage meltdowns
cards.body: Expert parents share practical tips for handling kids' meltdowns across all ages, from toddlerhood through the teenage years. These mood swings are actually reassuring markers of normal child development, though they can feel like minefields for parents.

cards.title: Baby-led weaning: messy truth explored
cards.body: An Edith Pritchett cartoon tackles the real challenges of baby-led weaning. The piece humorously examines the messy and sometimes toxic reality behind this popular feeding approach.

cards.title: Toddler culture deserves respect and understanding
cards.body: Small children have their own unique culture that shouldn't be dismissed by adults joining in uninvited. Respecting their world—from singing to collecting pee-covered leaves—matters more than many parents realize.

cards.title: Don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for kids
cards.body: Rockstar's latest game is rated 18 and stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence—the most graphic content the reviewer has encountered. Parents should absolutely not purchase this for children.

cards.title: Schools to prioritize pleasure reading for children
cards.body: New curriculum guidance encourages schools to set aside dedicated time for children to read for pleasure. The initiative aims to reverse declining literacy rates and combat excessive screen time.

cards.title: ADHD and autism diagnoses being reassessed in Sweden
cards.body: A government-funded clinic is re-evaluating people with ADHD and autism diagnoses who feel misdiagnosed. Critics worry the reassessments could deepen stigma despite many finding initial diagnoses affirming.
